import sqlite3

def check_unique_title(title):
    conn = sqlite3.connect('db.sqlite3')
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entries WHERE title = ?', (title,))
    count = cur.fetchone()[0]
    conn.close()
    return count == 0

# Example usage
print(check_unique_title("Sample Title"))  # Should return True if the title is unique, False otherwise
